seo.title: Case Study: Urban Clothing Online Store — E-commerce Template | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built a functional online store template, with a shopping cart, product categories, and a user profile with purchase history.

hero.title: E-commerce Template — a store that
hero.subtitle: Personal project: an online urban clothing store built as a template, designed to showcase a complete, functional purchase flow from end to end.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: Many businesses that want to sell online first need to see how a real store would work: adding products, watching the total update, and reviewing past purchases. The goal was to build a solid, reusable foundation that covers that entire flow.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I built an online store with a shopping cart, product categories, and a user profile with purchase history, working like a real store: users can add products, watch the total change, and review past purchases from their profile.
incluye: Reusable foundation as a template for new projects

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The template works like a real store from end to end, serving as a reference foundation for new e-commerce projects that need a complete purchase flow from day one.
